:::{#exm-laplace-density}
#### Laplace density values

Let $Y \sim \dLaplacef{3, 2}$, so $\mu = 3$ and $b = 2$ (@def-laplace).
At the location, $\abs{y - \mu} = 0$, so the density is $\frac{1}{2b}$.
At a point $y = 5$, the distance is $\abs{5 - 3} = 2 = b$, so the density is $\frac{1}{2b}\ef{-1}$.
Here are both values:

```{r}
#| label: laplace-density-values
#| code-fold: false
b <- 2
c(
  at_mu = 1 / (2 * b),
  at_mu_plus_2 = exp(-1) / (2 * b)
) |>
  round(3)
```

The density at $\mu + b$ is the density at $\mu$ times $\ef{-1}$,
and the same holds at $\mu - b$, because the density depends only on the distance from $\mu$.
:::
